zh-CN.name: 视频剪辑
zh-CN.summary: 多轨视频剪辑、声音与原创动效；与独立视频剪辑师协作，保留人工编辑。
zh-CN.description: 多轨视频剪辑、声音与原创动效；与独立视频剪辑师协作，保留人工编辑。 复用 FableCut 时间线、浏览器合成器与 MCP 核心，界面跟随 DesireCore 明暗主题。需要 Node.js 22+、显式准备的浏览器和 FFmpeg/ffprobe，以及 app-authoring-v1 的 release/runtime-binding 能力。当前目录限定 Windows 与 Ubuntu/WSLg 已测范围；macOS 待验，不声明正式签名安装器或自主模型质量已通过。 模型额度、可选外部媒体服务的许可、账户与费用另计；应用不默认选择付费生成。

en-US.name: Video Editing
en-US.summary: Multitrack editing, sound and original motion with the independent Video Editor agent, preserving human edits.
en-US.description: Reuses the FableCut timeline, browser compositor and MCP core with DesireCore light/dark appearance. Requires Node.js 22+, explicitly prepared browser and FFmpeg/ffprobe assets, and app-authoring-v1 release/runtime-binding capabilities. The listing covers bounded Windows and Ubuntu/WSLg source-GUI qualification. macOS is pending; signed installers, official Linux packages, bare-metal GPU and autonomous model quality are not qualified. Model quota and optional external media service licenses, accounts and fees are separate; the application selects no paid generation service by default.
